import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        while (scanner.hasNext()) {
            String s = scanner.next();
            if (s.isEmpty()) continue;
            StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder();
            out.append(s.charAt(0));
            int i = 1;
            boolean atReplaced = false;
            while (i < s.length()) {
                int nextAt = s.indexOf("at", i);
                int nextDot = s.indexOf("dot", i);
                if (!atReplaced && nextAt != -1 && (nextDot == -1 || nextAt < nextDot)) {
                    out.append(s, i, nextAt);
                    out.append('@');
                    atReplaced = true;
                    i = nextAt + 2;
                } else if (nextDot != -1 && (nextAt == -1 || nextDot < nextAt || atReplaced)) {
                    out.append(s, i, nextDot);
                    out.append('.');
                    i = nextDot + 3;
                } else {
                    out.append(s.substring(i));
                    break;
                }
            }
            System.out.println(out.toString());
        }
        scanner.close();
    }
}
